🎬 Hit Man (2023)

Hit Man follows Gary Johnson, a mild-mannered college professor who secretly works with the New Orleans police by pretending to be a professional hitman during undercover operations. Gifted at creating convincing disguises and personalities, Gary helps authorities catch people attempting to hire assassins. However, his carefully controlled double life takes an unexpected turn when he meets Madison, a woman seeking help escaping her troubled marriage. As their attraction grows, Gary becomes increasingly tangled in his invented identity, leading to dangerous lies, romantic complications, and unexpected twists. Combining clever comedy, romance, crime, and suspense, the film explores identity, deception, love, and the consequences of pretending to be someone else.

🎭 Genre: Romantic Comedy • Crime • Thriller

⭐ IMDb: 6.8/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 55m • R

🎥 Director: Richard Linklater

🏆 Recognition: Starring Glen Powell and Adria Arjona, the film premiered at the 2023 Venice International Film Festival and received critical acclaim for its clever screenplay, humor, and lead performances. It was inspired by a Texas Monthly article about a real undercover investigator.

📺 Where to Watch: Netflix in the United States. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Hit Man is a 2023 American romantic crime comedy film produced and directed by Richard Linklater, who co-wrote the screenplay with Glen Powell. The film stars Powell, Adria Arjona, Austin Amelio, Retta, and Sanjay Rao. It follows an undercover New Orleans police contractor who poses as a reliable hitman as he tries to save a woman in need. The basic premise was based on the true story of a college professor who worked for the Houston police in the late 1980s and 1990s as a fake hitman, as described in a 2001 magazine article by Skip Hollandsworth.
